KEY PRODUCT FEATURES:
• 8 Innistrad: Crimson Vow MTG Set Boosters
• 1 foil alt-art promo card
• 40 basic land cards (20 foil + 20 nonfoil)
• Spindown life counter + card storage box
• Return to the gothic horror plane of Innistrad for a sumptuous vampire wedding—as honored guest or delicious entrée

DESCRIPTION:
The Innistrad: Crimson Vow Bundle contains 8 Innistrad: Crimson Vow Set Boosters—the best boosters to open just for fun—plus exclusive accessories, with 40 basic lands (20 traditional foils and 20 nonfoils), 1 traditional foil alt-art promo card, 1 exclusive oversized Spindown life counter, 1 card storage box, and 2 reference cards. Each Innistrad: Crimson Vow Set Booster contains 12 Magic cards, 1 Art Card, and 1 token, ad card, Helper card, or special card from Magic's history (a card from "The List"), with a combination of 1–4 Rares and/or Mythic Rares, 2–7 Uncommons, 3–8 Commons, and 1 Land card in every pack.
